title: LLM能否真正理解题目难度？对使用LLM自动生成试题的启示
summary: 该研究评估了LLM在预测大规模阅读与写作测试题目难度上的表现。零样本GPT-4.1（温度0）达到最高准确率（QWK=0.578），但仍低于ConvBERT（0.625）。所有LLM难以识别难题，GPT-5.4倾向低估难度，嵌入分析表明语义信息不足以预测难度，提示使用LLM生成特定难度题目需谨慎。
summary_en: This study evaluates LLMs' performance in predicting item difficulty in a large-scale reading and writing test. Zero-shot GPT-4.1 achieved the highest accuracy (QWK=0.578) but still lower than ConvBERT (0.625). All LLMs struggled with hard items, GPT-5.4 underestimated difficulty, and embeddings showed semantic information is insufficient, cautioning against using LLMs to generate items with targeted difficulty.
